name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Respiratory Lab
summary:
Step into the Respiratory Lab of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where the organs of breathing come to life in stunning 3D. Anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors for elementary, middle, and high school learners, teaches students how the respiratory system works together to support life.
